name: github-manager
description: Engineering manager skills that compute from exported GitHub data: a stuck-PR and review-queue digest with next actions, an iteration report with shipped, carried-over and newly opened work plus cycle time and review turnaround, a blameless incident postmortem timeline, and an issue triage digest (unlabelled, unanswered, possible duplicates, stale, popular, suggested labels). Every number and row cites the PR, issue, comment or event it came from; team level only, no per-person scoring.
